mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_my_product (member_email, product_name, brand_name, model_name, cert_num, image_name) VALUES (#{memberEmail}, #{productName}, #{brandName}, #{modelName}, #{certNum}, #{imageName})
mapper.select: SELECT product_no, member_email, product_name, brand_name, model_name, cert_num, image_name, recall_matched, recall_type, recall_uid, recall_title, checked_time, reg_time, del_flag FROM tbl_my_product WHERE product_no = #{productNo} AND del_flag = FALSE

SELECT product_no, member_email, product_name, brand_name, model_name, cert_num, image_name, recall_matched, recall_type, recall_uid, recall_title, checked_time, reg_time, del_flag FROM tbl_my_product WHERE member_email = #{memberEmail} AND del_flag = FALSE ORDER BY recall_matched DESC, reg_time DESC

SELECT product_no, member_email, product_name, brand_name, model_name, cert_num, image_name, recall_matched, recall_type, recall_uid, recall_title, checked_time, reg_time, del_flag FROM tbl_my_product WHERE recall_matched = FALSE AND del_flag = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_my_product SET recall_matched = #{recallMatched}, recall_type = #{recallType}, recall_uid = #{recallUid}, recall_title = #{recallTitle}, checked_time = #{checkedTime} WHERE product_no = #{productNo}

UPDATE tbl_my_product SET product_name = #{productName}, brand_name = #{brandName}, model_name = #{modelName}, cert_num = #{certNum}, image_name = #{imageName}, recall_matched = #{recallMatched}, recall_type = #{recallType}, recall_uid = #{recallUid}, recall_title = #{recallTitle}, checked_time = #{checkedTime} WHERE product_no = #{productNo}
UPDATE tbl_my_product SET del_flag = TRUE WHERE product_no = #{productNo}
